messages.text: Can I over lock this unit? Of yes what’s the safest setting?

Short answer: don't. Overclocking voids the warranty on these, so there's no setting I'd call safe to hand you — we don't publish one for the H15.

Stock cooling on the Harlo units was reworked to run quiet at spec, and that's where they're happiest.

Is noise or heat the thing you're weighing here, or raw hashrate?
Hashrate, wondering if this could push 18/th?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Handed to the team · H15 Dual hashrate/overclock headroom not in product facts and the live listing w

I won't quote you a number I haven't confirmed — JD's picking that up here, and he'll have the H15's rated figure and whether there's any headroom at all.

If hashrate per dollar is the goal, the Magic Miner 40T is the better buy anyway: 40 TH/s at $799, ships November 21, 2026. More than double the 18 you're after, for less money.

Want me to price that one out at your power rate?
No I like the idea of sooo liking for dodge while the btc pays for the electric

Fair — that dual setup is the draw. Straight with you: at home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity, that's not why people buy it. The draw is the Doge side plus a real block shot on BTC.

The H15 isn't buyable yet — the drop date hasn't been announced, ships November 14. Notify me is the only way on.

Want a pair you can run now instead?
What’s the power settings on the kbeast?

For the Doge-plus-BTC idea, the pieces are live today: Hammer DC06, 330 MH/s at ~105 W, $379.99, and a NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s on the Bitcoin side.

Good — US stock works for both sides.

Doge: Hammer DC06, 330 MH/s at ~105 W, $379.99. Bitcoin: Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at ~166 W, $369, both shipping from US stock. About 270 W together, roughly $19 a month at 10¢/kWh.
